title: Add dissector for DECT DLC protocol layer
description:
This adds a dissector for the DECT DLC protocol layer as requested in #15741 . Currently this is basically a combination of the initial code provided by Harald Welte in the issue and code for reassembly from the lapdm dissector.
It depends on fragment information from the lower layer dissector.

commits_data.title: DECT-DLC: Unify variable naming
commits_data.message:
DECT-DLC: Unify variable naming

Naming of variables, i.e. for header fields was inconsistent (dlc_ vs
dect_dlc_). This is now changed to use the abbreviation (dect_dlc_) on
all global places.

commits_data.title: DECT-DLC: Fix typos in hf definitions
commits_data.message: DECT-DLC: Fix typos in hf definitions

commits_data.title: DECT-DLC: Reassemble fragments
commits_data.message:
DECT-DLC: Reassemble fragments

The DECT-DLC dissector now reassembles fragments before handing them
over to the NWK layer. Most of this is done by reusing of the reassembly code
from packet-lapdm.c.

commits_data.title: DECT-DLC:DECT-DLC:  Really disable abandoned func
commits_data.message:
DECT-DLC:DECT-DLC:  Really disable abandoned func

The preprocessor definition to disable the stub
proto_reg_handoff_dect_aastra in packet-dect-dlc did not work, so it's
disabled via comment now.
